findings.forcedInvention: A `/create-prd` author must invent an accountable resolver and calendar cutoff before deciding whether Timestamped Annotation is one cross-cut contract or independent 05/06/07 models, because the source supplies only a provisional owner and target stage.
findings.failureScenario: Architecture starts before the promotion decision is assigned and due. Domains 05, 06, and 07 create incompatible timestamped-note records, after which a later owner decision requires cross-domain migration and reconciliation.
